Ryanair's Articles let the Directors limit the shares in which non-EU nationals have an interest, and the exercise of their rights, including voting, where that could protect the licences it needs to operate air services. notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2025 (Ryanair's FY25; matches data.js fy 'Mar 2025'). Source is Ryanair Holdings plc's FY2025 Form 20-F as filed with the SEC (filed May 19, 2025), which reports in euro, so currency is EUR. OWNERSHIP: the 20-F's major-shareholder table is as of March 31, 2025 and is 'based on information available to Ryanair Holdings'. It does not cite individual holder filings, so each holder's asOf is the table date. Percentages are '% of Class' of the 1,063,868,001 Ordinary Shares outstanding. O'LEARY: 44,099,892 Ordinary Shares (4.1%); the Directors as a group held 44,774,182 shares, about 4%. His relation is 'ceo' (Group CEO; data.js role 'Group CEO'). HSBC Holdings PLC is typed 'other' because the 20-F does not say whether it holds for its own account or as custodian or nominee. STOCK COMP: €12.8m, which rounds to 0.01 billion; FY2024 was a credit of €3.9m. Share awards are made under Option Plan 2013 and LTIP 2019, which the 20-F describes in terms of senior employees, managers and directors; no broad employee share purchase plan was found in the 20-F, so plan is null. DIVIDENDS: €437.7m paid in FY2025 (Note 24). BUYBACKS: €1,477.8m in FY2025 under the €700m program launched in May 2024 and the €800m follow-on launched in August 2024.
